text:
anya: FYI - small onboarding sample (TS + Vite) fails in the edge preview. Two distinct symptoms: `ReferenceError: Buffer is not defined` on cold import, and Authorization header disappears when we proxy to /internal. Repro steps: build preview -> curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer TEST' /api/proxy -> missing header; console shows Buffer error.

marco: can you share package.json + vite config? are you bundling the sdk (ssr.noExternal)?

anya: package.json is ESM (type: 'module'), and vite has `ssr: { noExternal: ['redwood-inference'] }`. import: `import Redwood from 'redwood-inference'`.

rachel: common issue. SDK references Buffer in a rare code path; bundlers often drop node shims. Edge runtimes don't provide Buffer. Also, many edge platforms strip Authorization for internal rewrites unless you forward headers explicitly.

sam: for the header problem, in Vercel edge we had to create a new Request with the original headers: `const req2 = new Request(targetUrl, { method: req.method, headers: req.headers, body: req.body })` and call `fetch(req2)`. Rewrites to internal endpoints can lose credentials.

marco: proposed SDK fix: lazy guard for Buffer. Something like: `if (typeof Buffer === 'undefined') { try { const mod = await import('buffer/'); globalThis.Buffer = mod.Buffer } catch(_) { /* continue */ } }` done only when needed. That avoids forcing polyfills on all bundles.

rachel: agreed. Also a TS/interop note: some consumers with `esModuleInterop: false` get import style confusion (`import * as Redwood` vs `import Redwood`). We should publish a types compatibility shim (export = / default) so both import styles work.

marco: devex docs: short page with examples for Vite/Webpack/Rollup + edge tips. Quick snippets: Vite - `optimizeDeps.include: ['buffer']` and `ssr.noExternal: ['redwood-inference']`. Webpack - `resolve.fallback: { buffer: require.resolve('buffer/') }`. Rollup - alias `buffer` to `buffer/` and enable node-resolve plugin.

anya: I'll add a tiny private repro repo and a CI preview test that curls the endpoint so the build fails until fixed.

rachel: I'll open a PR: (1) lazy Buffer fallback, (2) d.ts compatibility tweak, (3) runtime warning when Buffer missing pointing to devex doc. ETA 48 hrs.

sam: temporary workaround for customers: at top of edge handler do `globalThis.Buffer = globalThis.Buffer || (await import('buffer/')).Buffer` and ensure proxy code forwards headers. Add that to onboarding quickstart.

ci-bot: created issue RF-358: "edge: vite sample - Buffer missing + proxy header repro"

marco: once PR lands, we should add a CI integration that builds a Vite edge preview in emulation to catch regressions.

rachel: will tag reviewers. thanks for the repro, anya. this one is painful for new users, good we caught it early. :rocket:
